findings.detail: While line 364 adds 'A **bug is NOT exempt' (satisfying the grep check) and line 363 names session_log/code_review/identity as exempt, two stale statements remain that still claim bugs are exempt from the gate: (1) line 52-53 in the 'Not-claimable fast-fail' subsection says 'Bugs and session_logs are exempt from the whole gate and unaffected.' and (2) line 1136 in the 'Scope (v1)' section says 'Bugs are exempt (a dedicated follow-on).' The substantive requirement — that the doc no longer claims bugs are exempt — is not fully met.
findings.remediation: Remove or correct the two stale statements: (1) at line 52-53, replace 'Bugs and session_logs are exempt from the whole gate and unaffected.' with a statement that reflects that bugs now get a light advisory review (or remove the sentence); (2) at line 1136, remove or update 'Bugs are exempt (a dedicated follow-on).' to reflect that the bug review tier is now implemented.
